gen-gf-bellota-gf-gentium-plus: Swinging, tube-like letters up top, hung with loose-ended s shapes. Gentium Plus follows in a classic serif whose wide-mouthed c keeps a long page of text easy to move through, with thick and thin strokes giving it a pen-written pulse.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gowun-batang: Commanding, this heading: Bellota draws every stroke at one stylus width. Gowun Batang, a literary serif with terminals cut back to leave big gaps, is the quality that matters most, since it gives the pair a stiff-versus-supple tension.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-habibi: Chunky, bold lettering with hanging s ends leads the way. Habibi, a classic serif with clear channels into its round letters, brings in thicker and thinner strokes, so a modest body size lets that detail show.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-inika: Inika reads like a classic serif, warm and traditional. Its see-through s shapes meet Bellota's uniform, tube-like strokes, and that gap between a flat-weight display face and a modulated body is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kay-pho-du: Kay Pho Du brings a traditional text serif, its counters breathing like a cut reed. Bellota is best at announcing, with distinctive s shapes at constant width, while Kay Pho Du is best at carrying a paragraph with a rolling-ball pen's trail.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-labrada: Dignified is Labrada, a bookish text serif with wide openings on its small letters, set against Bellota's bent-neon tubing of constant thickness. That mismatch between glowing display and studious body is where the pair gets its charm.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-laila: Bellota's s ends hang far from the spine, and every stroke is cut to one single width, giving it a tube-like, commanding look. Laila, a classic serif, counters that with generous space between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-new-tegomin: Bellota leads with hanging s ends and counters outlined in a single steady thickness. New Tegomin, a dignified classic serif with a c like a wide-open ring, sits next to it feeling older, quieter, and more varied in stroke.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-podkova: Podkova is bookish and traditional, a text serif with broad, welcoming c shapes. Under Bellota's monoline skeleton, a long page would feel like a bold, distinctive banner above a steady, varied-stroke body.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-rhodium-libre: Editorial in mood, this pair starts with Bellota, whose distinctive s and carefully matched mass in every letter part make headings stand out. Rhodium Libre, a classic serif, does the opposite job best, lifting brush ends away before each curve closes.
